pythonFunction.name: session_store_write
pythonFunction.description:
Writes the session close-out summary (language, authentication path, handoff reason,
confirmation numbers) to the session store. Idempotent: calling it again updates the same
record. No spoken pacing is needed; this tool is silent and background.

Args:
    session_context: Short plain-text summary of the session: what was done and any
        confirmation numbers (REQUIRED). Never include verification digits.

Returns:
    dict with ok.
